# List the registered diagnostics

<small>Source: [`R/diagnosticsRegistry.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/diagnosticsRegistry.R) · Help: `?listDiagnostics`</small>

Returns the names [`runHeteroTests()`](runHeteroTests.md) accepts in `tests`: the diagnostics
the package registers and any added with [`registerDiagnostic()`](registerDiagnostic.md).

## Usage

```r
listDiagnostics()
```

## Value

A character vector of the registered names, sorted.

## Details

`"box_m"` is registered for [`runMultivariateTests()`](runMultivariateTests.md), which calls it with
data and a grouping factor rather than with a model.

## See also

[`registerDiagnostic()`](registerDiagnostic.md), [`runHeteroTests()`](runHeteroTests.md)

## Examples

```r
listDiagnostics()
```
